correctness.rationale: All 2619 nonempty matching faces are generated exhaustively; the totals of flags are 2619,21546,41580,22680 flags across dimensions 0..3, with 293,2394,4620,2520 flag-orbit cells. Signed boundaries square to zero. Exact integer unimodular elimination gives nonzero Smith factors (1 repeated 292), (1 repeated 2101 plus 3), (1 repeated 2511 plus 3). Residual all 2x2 minors vanish and entry gcd equals 3. Hence H1=Z/3, H2=Z^6+Z/3, H3=Z^8. Armstrong and explicit rotation fixed matchings imply pi1=C3. Standalone verifier reruns these checks. As an independent Euler check, Burnside gives chi(Q)=(-27+9+9)/9=-1 from the nine fixed matching barycenters for each order-three rotation.

value.rationale: Nine is the least odd composite size, the first natural test of a nonfree proper-rotation stabilizer in an odd cyclic matching complex. Exact C9 orbit homology shows independent order-three torsion in consecutive degrees plus free ranks 6 and 8, a natural integer classification not derivable from ambient homology, rational characters, or the fundamental group. A motivated finite exact invariant is substantial without an artificial extension. The ambient M9 homology table has eight Z/3 summands in degree two and free rank 70 in degree three, but does not determine how nonfree rotation changes those groups.
